privacy: Neutral invented messages, devices and receipts only; no tokens, push endpoints, chat IDs or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
title: Owner: a brief arrives on the phone first
goal: The owner sees a brief or update notice arrive as a push first and on Telegram only when not tapped
acceptance: On NERV-01 after the update: a brief tapped within 10 minutes never reaches Telegram; one left alone reaches Telegram once at the deadline (F-133-T03 page)
validation: Owner device check, recorded in F-133 Verification

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: two briefs and a 12-minute wait, in the same phone sitting as F-004-T10. Not a measurement.
